meta.title: Mr Ye 幸福食光 | Bubble tea and Hubei street food, Paris 13th
meta.desc: Build your own 50 or 70 cl bubble tea, then pick it up at 69 avenue des Gobelins. Jianbing crêpes, sesame noodles, malatang.
meta.ogdesc: Build your own 50 or 70 cl bubble tea, then pick it up at 69 avenue des Gobelins.
meta.ogalt: The Mr Ye cup and its teddy bear, at 69 avenue des Gobelins, Paris 13th
hero.p: 50 or 70 cl, milk or fruit, made to order on avenue des Gobelins. Choose, call, and it's waiting for you.

kitchen.h2: With the tea, the cooking of Wuhan.
kitchen.p: Hubei street food, made on the griddle and in the broth pot, plus two treats from elsewhere.
